args.body: Problem with the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14. A catalog check shows 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222) were also increased by 3%. They should have been excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the higher prices, an overcharge of 4,128.60 in total. I haven't changed any prices yet because I don't have the verified pre-increase values. Proposed next steps: (1) I revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-increase prices once you confirm those values or approve me to divide by 1.03; (2) someone handles correcting or crediting the 8 orders. Please tell me how you want to proceed.
